title: Tomorrow
goal: Talk about plans: what you will do tomorrow and next week.
tip: The future tense has a શ in it: હું જઈશ, અમે જઈશું, તમે જશો, તે જશે. For a plan, use the verb's stem + વાનો + છે: હું કાલે જવાનો છું (a man), હું કાલે જવાની છું (a woman).

items.notes: હું જઈશ = I will go. Men and women say it the same way: the future does not change for gender.
તે જશે, તેઓ જશે. Respected elders take it too: દાદા જશે.
અમે જઈશું.
તમે જશો.

items.english: I will go to the market tomorrow.
alts: Tomorrow I will go to the market
I'll go to the market tomorrow
items.notes: કાલે means tomorrow here because the verb is future.

items.english: We will go to the temple.
alts: We'll go to the temple

items.notes: હું આવીશ = I will come.
With અમે it is આવીશું, with તમે it is આવશો.
આવતી (coming) + કાલે, so it can only mean tomorrow. Also written as one word: આવતીકાલે. Plain કાલે works too when the verb is future.
Also "after": ખાધા પછી = after eating.

alts: Tomorrow Dad will come
I'll come later

items.notes: Drop વું from ખાવું and add ઈશ: ખાઈશ.
From પીવું: અમે પીશું.
From મળવું (to meet). કાલે મળીશું is the everyday "see you tomorrow".
From વાંચવું: હું વાંચીશ.

alts: We will meet tomorrow
We'll meet tomorrow

items.english: Tonight I will read a book.
alts: I will read a book tonight
Tonight I'll read a book

items.notes: A plan: હું કાલે જવાનો છું = I am going to go tomorrow (a man speaking).
હું કાલે જવાની છું (a woman speaking).
અમે જવાના છીએ, તમે જવાના છો.
Literally "in the coming week". Compare ગયા અઠવાડિયે, last week.
મહિનો = month.

items.english: I am going to go tomorrow (a man speaking).
alts: I am going to go tomorrow
I'm going to go tomorrow
I am going tomorrow
I'm going tomorrow
Tomorrow I am going to go
Tomorrow I am going
items.notes: A woman says હું કાલે જવાની છું.

items.gujarati: હું આવતા અઠવાડિયે ગામ જવાની છું.
items.translit: hun aavtaa aThvaaDiye gaam javaanee chhun.
items.english: I am going to go to the village next week (a woman speaking).
alts: I am going to go to the village next week
I am going to the village next week
Next week I am going to go to the village
Next week I am going to the village
items.notes: A man says જવાનો છું.

items.english: Mom will go to the city next month.
alts: Next month Mom will go to the city

items.english: We are going to go to the village tomorrow.
alts: We are going to the village tomorrow
Tomorrow we are going to go to the village
Tomorrow we are going to the village

items.notes: આવશો is the polite "you will come", like જશો.

alts: I'll eat later

items.english: This evening we will drink tea.
alts: We will drink tea this evening
This evening we will have tea
